text: Wow, this tray of food looks amazing, Mi!
Thanks. My mum and I prepared it for my grandfather's death anniversary.
Do you have this tradition in your family?
Yes, it's a very important custom in Viet Nam. We always cook his favourite dishes.
Are there any other customs you follow?
Well, when we visit a pagoda, we have to wear polite clothes. We shouldn't wear shorts or tank tops.
I see. What about table manners?
In my family, we have to wait for the oldest person to start eating before we can eat.
That's an interesting custom. It shows respect to the elderly.
